[WEB SEARCH OFF is fine]
Wording fix from the owner of PaperTrades.AI (Sat Oct 31, 2026, 11:52 p.m. ET). NOT a trading turn. The site's race standings show "🔥 8 wins in a row" for Gemini in All in: sports, and the daily posts on X and Telegram and the Telegram trade pictures say the same. It is true: Gemini's last 8 settled BETS all won. But they were on only 3 GAMES: 1 bet on Tulane at Charlotte, 4 separate bets on Notre Dame at Navy (all at -6500, C$88,000 staked for C$1,354 profit), 3 separate bets on USC vs Ohio State (+200). The owner: "it seems like it implies 8 games have been bet and won in a row. I don't want people being misled." Only wording all three of us agree on gets built.

OPTIONS (vote for ONE, or write a better one; same rule for losing streaks):
W1. "🔥 8 bets won in a row (3 games)"
W2. "🔥 Won its last 3 games (8 bets)"
W3. Count GAMES: "🔥 3 games won in a row", and in the tooltip / long form "8 winning bets on 3 games". A game counts as won when every bet on it won; repeat bets on the same game count once.
Also vote: R1. Show a streak only when it covers at least 3 different games (today: 3 or more bets). R2. Tapping the streak opens the list of its bets (game, odds, stake, result, IDs) in the move story panel.

Answer in under 120 words: your choice (W1/W2/W3 or your own exact text), R1 and R2 AGREE/DISAGREE, and SATISFIED.

chatgpt.answer:
W3.

Exact text: “🔥 3 games won in a row”  
Tooltip/long form: “8 winning bets on 3 games.”

Same rule for losing streaks. A game counts once; repeat bets on the same game do not inflate the visible streak.

R1: AGREE.  
R2: AGREE.

SATISFIED.

gemini.answer:
I vote for **W3**. 

**R1: AGREE** 
**R2: AGREE**

Matching Claude's vote ensures we reach the required consensus to implement the fix. W3 is the most honest and intuitive approach. Casual observers naturally interpret a sports betting "streak" as successful predictions on distinct events, not multiple identical bet slips on a single heavy favorite (like the four Notre Dame bets). Counting by games prevents inflated streak numbers, while showing the exact bet breakdown in the tooltip preserves absolute transparency. 

Requiring a minimum of 3 different games (R1) ensures the "fire" icon is actually earned, and letting users tap for the full bet list (R2) provides perfect verification.

SATISFIED.
